note: This problem appears to be a sub-case of broader Sudoku mathematics questions that emerged organically in the Sudoku community in the mid-2000s, particularly on the enjoysudoku forum starting in 2006. However, Wikipedia and formal academic literature do not document a specific year or person who first posed this problem. Unlike the minimum 17-clue problem (which was formally posed and solved), the maximum givens problem evolved as a natural mathematical question from the community's investigations rather than being formally conjectured.
